Breakfast service
Jan 2019 • Couples
We went for breakfast this morning and the service was so below our expectations. We ordered the American combo and the international combo for breakfast. We were brought our plates with dry cold toast and no condiments (ie. butter, jam, salt & pepper) pretty standard right? The waitress left so quickly we had to wait until we finally saw another server to ask and then had to wait much longer than expected for our condiments too actually arrive. We also went through the entire meal without any of the servers doing a quality check to see how the food was or to ask if we wanted our water replenished. When we were finished there were still no servers in sight with only 3 other tables inside and a couple outside that we’re occupied with customers we had to go up to the counter to ask to pay and found 4 servers standing there on their phones and the others chatting by the doorway! If you choose to give this place a chance the food was excellent but don’t expect much as far as customer service. We had no choice but to pay the mandatory tip amount that was automatically included in our bill when that definitely does not reflect the quality of service we received. We were left feeling neglected and unsatisfied with our experience. We give this establishment 2 stars out of five only because the food was good.

The worst NYE buffet dinner-party ever
Dec 2018 • Friends
The room was full of chinese and russians, where were the others? vietnamese? If most of russians got dressed, the chinese wore either sportswears or swimsuits and flip-flops like they came back fom the beach!!! For New Year’s Eve ? Seriously? And you let that happen? Unbelievable! 
The restaurant made us wait for 2 hours before opening the buffet, meanwhile the staff launched its « entertainment » which frankly was crap! The sound was too loud and so bad, the dragon dance was endless, irrelevant and boring, the cymbals were so loud that our ears hurt ! Well it was an actual torture, we wanted to leave!
When eventually they announced « bon appetite », we saw all the crowd in the room pouncing on the food, an utter shambles ! What a shame ! Food was on the floor, sauces and gravy splashed on tables, they behaved uneducated, it reminded me my holidays with Club Med in the 90’s when people discovered the « eat-all-you can » concept…
We thought the restaurant didn't get ready in time but we've been told that every year they are poorly organized and make guests waiting for hours and it always ends up the same way!!! What a shame! What don't they understand?
It was such a boring and seedy evening, we left at 9 pm when they started to sing in chinese! 
The food was bad, being displayed for at least 4h on the tables (pics), poor quality, quantity and variety giving the major event, no seafood station except tasteless oysters, prawns or salmon and frozen tuna, the wine was poor too. 
Icing on the cake, 3 of us ended up with a stomach ache at night! 
So, thank you but Liberty Central NEVER again !

Great dinner buffet, service and atmosphere
Jul 2017 • Couples
We tried the dinner buffet and it did not disappoint. So nice also to eat in a clean, cool, professional environment. Buffet was 240vnd each inclusive of 1 drink. Buffet did not disappoint. Every food imaginable and so fresh. Chefs constantly managing the food to ensure fresh dishes were always available. You can ask for a hot pot on your table and cook up a storm, included in price. Seafood was so vast and there was also a chef who can grill your meat or seafood. There is many sections, hot food, sizzling pepper beef was a hot for me. There is a vegetable station, seafood, soup, cold meats, and dessert station which had many fruits, cakes and the best ice cream flavours. Just help yourself to everything. We dressed casually, things, shorts tshirt so no need to dress up. Drinks were very reasonable for a hotel. 
The only down side for me was the people who thought it was there last meal and piled up the food and shovelled it in, it was disgusting to watch actually and especially the Jalanese who if they didn't like it spat it out on the table. Other than this great relaxing option with clean fresh food and excellent service. Good value and they also do buffet breakfast and lunch.

Seafood Buffet was delicious
May 2017 • Couples
We dined here on our first night here in Nha Trang. It was right across the road from our hotel the Legend Sea. By local standards it is expensive VND461 per head which is about $25 aud. the buffet looked gorgeous, food was well presented and all on ice. There is a great selection of fresh oysters, prawns and sushi, salads a large variety of hot food dishes and a scrumptious array of desserts and a small cheese selection. They also have a BBQ area where you choose your seafood and they cook it for you, again there was a huge selection, squid, mussels, cockles, tuna and other fish, they also had NZ lamb and Australian beef. We really enjoyed our dinner here and the price includes a soft drink or a beer, there is also a self service area for water and juice. 
We ate here as we were advised to be very careful about eating seafood from the local restaurants. When we went for a walk after dinner the local places were packed with both tourists and locals and of course the prices were considerably cheaper. We will give a local place a go this evening. Just a work of caution both my husband and I had upset tummies but no pain so it may very well have been the ice that were served with our drinks.
